name: Octop
description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
one_liner: A ChatGPT-style AI assistant that a company runs entirely on its own servers, with support for multiple employees and multiple specialized AI 'agents', so no company data ever leaves the building.
buyer: An IT director at a law firm, hospital, or financial firm who wants staff to use AI chat but is barred from sending confidential data to public AI vendors.
business_use_cases: A law firm deploys it internally so associates can draft and research with AI without client documents ever touching an outside API.
A managed-IT provider offers 'private company ChatGPT' installation and maintenance as a service for regulated small businesses.
A healthcare clinic uses it for internal documentation help while staying compliant with patient-data rules.

money_ideas.idea: Offer white-glove installation and hosting of a private instance for regulated businesses
Run ongoing maintenance, updates, and support as a monthly managed-service contract

steal_this: This weekend, package a one-click deployment for a specific regulated industry (e.g. small law firms) and sell it as a fixed-price 'private AI in a box' setup.
